rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something gently or softly, especially with a light touch.

example.english: I held the kitten tenderly so I wouldn't hurt it.
example.traditional: 我輕輕咁抱住隻小貓，免得整親佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 heng6 heng1 gam3 pou5 zyu6 zek3 siu2 maau1 min5 dak1 zing2 can1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when the manner is affectionate, loving, or emotionally tender rather than merely light.

example.english: I tenderly hugged my mother and told her not to be afraid.
example.traditional: 我溫柔咁攬住阿媽，叫佢唔使驚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan1 jau4 gam3 laam5 zyu6 aa3 maa1 giu3 keoi5 m4 sai2 geng1
